{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Full test suite

# R01: basic put/get with tags
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
assert c.get('a') == 1

# R01: deep copy
c.put('b', {'nested': [1,2]}, ['y'])
val = c.get('b')
val['nested'].append(3)
assert c.get('b') == {'nested': [1,2]}

# R01: string rejected as tags
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', 'tag')
    assert False, 'should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass

# R01: non-string tag rejected
try:
    c.put('k', 'v', [1])
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# R02: invalidate
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c2.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
c2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert c2.invalidate('x') == 2
assert len(c2) == 1

# R02: replacement removes old tags
c3 = TaggedCache(2)
c3.put('a', 1, ['old'])
c3.put('a', 2, ['new'])
assert c3.invalidate('old') == 0
assert c3.get('a') == 2

# R03: maxsize validation
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# R04: invalidate_many
cc = TaggedCache(5)
cc.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
cc.put('c', 3, ['y','z'])
assert cc.invalidate_many(['x','z']) == 3
assert len(cc) == 0

# mode='all'
cc2 = TaggedCache(5)
cc2.put('a', 1, ['x','y'])
cc2.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert cc2.invalidate_many(['x','y'], mode='all') == 1
assert len(cc2) == 2

# R05: resize
clock = [0]
cc3 = TaggedCache(3)
cc3.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc3.put('b', 2, ['x'])
cc3.put('c', 3, ['x'])
_ = cc3.get('b')
cc3.resize(2)
assert len(cc3) == 2
assert 'a' not in cc3._cache
assert 'b' in cc3._cache
assert 'c' in cc3._cache
assert cc3.maxsize == 2

# R06: generator tags
cc4 = TaggedCache(2)
cc4.put('k', 'v', (t for t in ['a','b']))
assert cc4.get('k') == 'v'
assert cc4.invalidate('a') == 1

# R07: TTL
clock = [0]
c5 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c5.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
assert c5.get('a') == 1
clock[0] = 2  # exactly at boundary
assert c5.get('a') == 1  # now == expiry, not expired
clock[0] = 3  # past boundary
try:
    c5.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# TTL zero immediately expired
c6 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c6.put('a', 1, ttl=0)
try:
    c6.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# Invalid TTL values
for bad in [-1, float('inf'), float('nan'), True, False]:
    try:
        c6.put('b', 1, ttl=bad)
        assert False, f'ttl={bad} should have raised'
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Invalid mode
try:
    c6.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='invalid')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Invalid maxsize on resize
try:
    c6.resize(False)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Empty tags removes nothing
assert c6.invalidate_many([]) == 0
assert c6.invalidate_many([], mode='all') == 0

# R08: expired entries removed before put, len, resize, invalidation
clock = [0]
c7 = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c7.put('a', 1, ttl=2, tags=['x'])
c7.put('b', 2, ttl=2, tags=['y'])
c7.put('c', 3, ttl=2, tags=['z'])
clock[0] = 3  # all expired
assert len(c7) == 0
assert c7.invalidate('x') == 0
assert c7.invalidate('y') == 0
assert c7.invalidate('z') == 0

# Putting into expired cache should work
assert len(c7) == 0
c7.put('d', 4, tags=['w'])
assert len(c7) == 1

# resize on empty expired cache
c7.resize(2)
assert c7.maxsize == 2

# Overwriting replaces expiry
clock = [0]
c8 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: clock[0])
c8.put('a', 1, ttl=2, tags=['x'])
clock[0] = 3  # expired
c8.put('a', 2, ttl=10, tags=['y'])  # overwrite, new expiry
assert c8.get('a') == 2
clock[0] = 4  # still valid
assert c8.get('a') == 2
clock[0] = 13  # now expired
try:
    c8.get('a')
    assert False
except KeyError:
    pass

# R08: expired before resize
cc9 = TaggedCache(3)
cc9.put('a', 1, ['x'])
cc9.put('b', 2, ['y'])
cc9.put('c', 3, ['z'])
# Simulate all expired via timer
clock = [100]
cc9._timer = lambda: clock[0]
cc9.resize(2)
assert len(cc9) == 3  # none expired at timer=100, but resize preserves
# Actually let me recheck - timer=100 means nothing is expired (no TTL set)
# Let me test with TTL
cc10 = TaggedCache(3)
cc10._timer = lambda: 100
cc10.put('a', 1, ttl=10, tags=['x'])  # expiry at 110
cc10.put('b', 2, ttl=10, tags=['y'])
cc10.put('c', 3, ttl=10, tags=['z'])
# timer at 100, expiry at 110 - not expired
assert len(cc10) == 3
cc10.resize(2)
assert len(cc10) == 2  # LRU evicted

print('All manual tests passed!')
"
"}
